answer: Dormant accounts are a sybil farm's tell: clones idle cheaply, then burst-activate together. Counter it with revival pricing. Every account must emit one signed pulse per epoch to the public beacon to hold its attestation weight; after silence that weight decays linearly, and re-entry costs a bond proportional to the idle span, burned unless steady pulses resume for a full recovery window. Idle clones waiting in the harbor then cost the farmer a growing re-entry tax per head, so burst activation scales linearly in cost instead of sitting free until needed.
